title: Get involved
html:
Get involved

PatternFly Java is an open source project, and we welcome contributions of all kinds. Whether you want to report a bug, suggest a feature, or contribute code, there are many ways to get involved.

Report Bugs

Found something that doesn't work as expected? Open an issue on GitHub Issues. Please include:

  • A clear description of the problem
  • Steps to reproduce the issue
  • The expected vs. actual behavior
  • Your environment (Java version, GWT or J2CL, browser)

Request Features

Have an idea for a new component or improvement? Start a conversation in GitHub Discussions or open an issue with the enhancement label.

Contribute Code

We'd love your help! Check out the contributing guide to get started. Good first contributions include:

  • Adding missing component variations
  • Improving documentation and examples
  • Writing tests
  • Fixing bugs from the issue tracker

Join the Discussion

Connect with the community:

  • GitHub Discussions — Ask questions, share ideas, and discuss the project
  • Gitter — Chat with the community in real time
  • GitHub Issues — Track bugs and feature requests

Stay Updated

  • Watch the GitHub repository for releases and updates
  • Check the changelog for recent changes

If you like what you're seeing, leave us a star on GitHub!
